title: Progress Check 1 · Weeks 1–4
subtitle: 20 marks · no help · 20 minutes

sections.title: A. Complete the sentences (10 marks)
items: 1. I've been living in Alexandria ___ 2018.
2. How long ___ you been waiting?
3. She's tired because she ___ (work) all day.
4. When I got to the station, the train ___ (already / leave).
5. While I ___ (walk) home, it started to rain.
6. I'll call you as soon as I ___ (arrive).
7. Look at those black clouds! It ___ rain.
8. I'm not sure yet. I ___ go to the party.
9. He's been driving for ten hours. He ___ be tired.
10. That ___ be Ahmed. He's in London this week.

sections.title: B. Translate into English (5 marks)
items: 1. أبحث عن وظيفة منذ شهرين.
2. عندما وصلت الشرطة، كان اللص قد هرب.
3. سأطفئ الأنوار قبل أن أغادر.
4. لا بد أن شحن البطارية قد نفد.
5. ربما يكون في اجتماع.
answers: 1. I've been looking for a job for two months. / I have been looking for work for two months.
2. When the police arrived, the thief had run away. / When the police arrived, the thief had escaped.
3. I'll switch off the lights before I leave.
5. He might / could / may be in a meeting.

sections.title: C. Write the Arabic meaning (5 marks)
items: 3. pollution = __________
5. turn down (an offer) = __________

sections.title: D. Speaking check — tick what you can do
items: ☐ I can talk about my job and say how long I have been doing things.
☐ I can tell a story or a news report about the past.
☐ I can make predictions about the environment and say how sure I am.
☐ I can guess the reasons for problems (must / might / can't).

score: My score: ______ / 20   18–20 Excellent · 16–17 Very good · under 16: repeat the sentences of these weeks for 3 days, then try again.
